contracts: Domain.getRootDescriptors filters structural roots and excludes constants; RustDomainNaming.rustGeneratedBootstrap requires exactly one ordinary root.
Template rendering suppresses invalid-root bootstrap attribute evaluation and emits an incomplete runtime; the full original crate detects the missing module factory.
ObjectDescriptor.getIdentityConstants requires an identifier field and nonempty candidates, splits candidate and ID columns independently and supplies missing IDs through Candidate.
FieldDescriptor.getCandidateValue splits its own candidate/sample column and returns string 1 when the requested line is missing; missing XML cells are not reconstructed by observers.
Comma values, absent identifiers and declaration-derived candidates retain the original parser metadata before C++ recipe emission.
